content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This infrastructure is built on top of Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages, and NOWPayments, allowing sellers to create a fully functional online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. By leveraging blockchain technology, sellers can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This enables them to sell digital products to international buyers with ease and efficiency, without relying on traditional payment gateways that often come with high fees and limited functionality.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture works by using Cloudflare Pages as the hosting platform, GitHub Pages as the backend, and NOWPayments as the payment processor. When a customer places an order, the payment is processed automatically using NOWPayments, which receives the on-chain confirmation and fires a webhook to trigger the product delivery. This seamless integration enables sellers to focus on creating and selling digital products, rather than worrying about payment processing and logistics.

Your Deployment Checklist
